name: agent-blueprint
description: 53 skills and 5 hooks that take Codex from an idea to a reviewed pull request: design, plans, test-first code, reviews and handoffs between sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Take an idea to a reviewed PR
interface.longDescription:
Agent Blueprint gives Codex engineering skills that carry a change from an idea to a reviewed pull request. Brainstorm a design, settle the open decisions, write a plan, build it test-first, review it with parallel reviewers, verify it, and leave notes in docs/context/STATUS.md so the next session picks up where this one stopped.

Call a skill by name, such as $ab-brainstorming, or let Codex pick one from your request. Start with $ab-project-start, which sets up AGENTS.md, docs/context/ and BACKLOG.md and merges into files that already exist instead of overwriting them. $ab-build-pipeline stops for your approval after each stage, and $ab-ship-pipeline runs a feature end to end with no checkpoints.

The plugin also ships hooks for Codex: a session-start pointer to the project status, a prompt-injection guard on file writes, a commit-message check, a context monitor that warns after many tool calls, and the ship-pipeline Stop guard. Codex runs none of them until you review and trust them in /hooks. Every skill works without the hooks.

Agent Blueprint is open source under the MIT license.
